decision.reasoning_trace: During this shopping session for backpacks, I encountered many specialized items such as backpack beach chairs, backpacking tents, and even a paddle board with a backpack. I filtered these out to focus on actual storage backpacks. My consideration set includes a highly portable 20L packable daypack, a 45L tactical rucksack, a durable adidas mesh backpack, a baseball gear bag, and a leather sling bag. I ultimately chose the HIKPRO 20L packable backpack (prod_backpacks_006) because of its exceptional 4.7 rating and nearly 3,000 positive reviews, which highlight its durability and convenience for travel and hiking at an affordable $17.99 price point.
